caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet composed of three main sections, all in a light to medium brown wood tone with visible wood grain patterns. The upper section consists of two vertically-oriented rectangular doors, each with a small circular brass-colored knob, set within a flat frame. Below this section, there is a central drop-down panel, which is open and held level by two greenish metal supports on either side. Behind the drop-down panel is a compartmentalized area featuring several small vertical and horizontal cubbies for storage, all in a lighter wood or beige color. The base section of the cabinet has two more rectangular doors, also fitted with brass-colored knobs, and the entire cabinet stands against a blank, light beige background. The cabinet has a rectangular, box-like construction with flat surfaces and clean lines, and all doors are of similar design and proportion.
title: Shaker Desk
